an3.53:2.2: In the MS edition, there are two sections following that discuss, firstly, misconduct of body, speech, and mind (as at [an3.54:3.1]()); then acting for the benefit of oneself, others, and both (as at [an3.54:4.1]()). These sections are absent from many editions, and not translated by Bodhi. There’s also no trace of them in the repetitions below, or in the commentary. I assume they are inserted here by scribal error and so omit them in translation.
